description: This file defines the Subscription class within the Opencart system, specifically in the admin model for sales. It contains methods to manage subscription records such as editing subscription details, managing payment methods, updating subscription plans, remaining periods, and handling subscription history, along with fetching and counting subscription data based on various filters.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription records, providing methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and updating subscription-related data in the database.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates the subscription plan ID and customer payment ID for a given subscription.

methods.name: editPaymentMethod
methods.description: Updates the customer payment ID associated with a specific subscription.

methods.name: editSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Modifies the subscription plan ID for a particular subscription.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Sets the remaining period for a subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Sets the trial remaining period for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Updates the next scheduled date for a subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByCustomerPaymentId
methods.description: Deletes a subscription record based on the customer payment ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches a subscription's data by its subscription ID, decoding JSON fields as needed.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription based on associated order and product IDs.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns a list of subscriptions filtered by various criteria, including subscription ID, order ID, customer, date ranges, status, etc., with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Counts total subscriptions matching certain filters.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsByStoreId
methods.description: Counts total subscriptions for a specific store.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts total subscriptions by their status ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history record for a subscription, optionally notifying the customer.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Inserts a new history record for a specific subscription with status, comment, and notification options, and updates the subscription status in the database.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves paginated history entries for a specific subscription, including date added, status, comment, and notification flag, filtered by language.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for a given subscription.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts total history entries filtered by subscription status id.
